current.text: Reports from Rockets media day say Durant will play fewer minutes this season.
Lloyd expects about 36 minutes a game, maybe 35, because coach Ime Udoka plays his starters heavy minutes. If his minutes fall to 33, his value changes materially.
He hurt his ankle in last season's playoffs and is fine now.
He is a projected starter for Houston. More guard depth pushes him into a forward role, and he should play almost no shooting guard.

Most experts see him as a first-round player in category leagues and call him a value at his Yahoo rank of 14 to 15 and ADP of 16 to 17. In mock drafts he went at picks 12 and 17, and the speakers preferred him over Maxey, Jalen Johnson, Steph Curry and Scottie Barnes.
Experts call his ESPN rank of 28 far too low. Lloyd names him the best Rockets target in category leagues at that price.
He has the narrowest outcome range among round-two players: best case 6th, worst case 24th, not counting injury.
One expert expects a decline at age 37 and doubts he stays as healthy after last season's heavy minutes.
In an auction mock he went for 40 USD. Josh would pay into the 30s and called 40 USD too rich.
Houston is projected to win 54 games and is expected to stay conservative in the regular season rather than chase seeding.
With our March 28 end date, Houston has a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over weeks 19 to 21. The Rockets have only 14 back-to-backs.

durable.text: He is an efficient scorer who shoots well from the field and the line. His steals are low.
Turnovers are his one weak category, at about 3 a game, which is a league outlier.
He is worth much more in 9-cat category leagues than in points leagues.
At 37, the main worry is whether his body holds up.
Coach Ime Udoka is defense-first and plays his starters very heavy minutes.

note: Durant helps in every category except turnovers (about 3 a game), which makes him a natural fit for punt TO builds. Prices: Yahoo value 42 USD (average cost 43), ESPN value 26 USD (average cost 34), and he went for 44 USD in our league last season. In an expert mock he went for 40 USD, which Josh called too rich, so the low to high 30s looks like the sensible range. Watch his minutes early: the media day reports point to fewer, and Lloyd says his value changes materially if he drops to about 33 minutes. Houston's weak 10-game schedule in our playoff weeks is a small extra minus.
